variants.text: You open an umbrella, but the wind flips it inside out. Brace yourself in place, pull it closer, and try to flip it back.
performanceSteps: Open an umbrella
Brace yourself and pull the inside-out umbrella back into shape.

variants.text: You open an umbrella, but it's too small to cover your shoulders. Hunch up and shift it from side to side, trying to stay dry.
performanceSteps: Open an umbrella
Hunch your shoulders and move the tiny umbrella from side to side.

groups.sharedAction: Hold the steering wheel and drive

variants.text: You're driving when the steering wheel suddenly becomes stiff. Use both hands to turn it slowly and straighten the car.
performanceSteps: Hold the steering wheel and drive
Strain with both hands to turn the stiff wheel.

variants.text: You're driving when the steering wheel suddenly turns far too easily. Ease off and make tiny corrections to avoid oversteering.
performanceSteps: Hold the steering wheel and drive
Ease your grip and make tiny steering corrections.

variants.text: You pull up a suitcase handle, but it keeps extending higher and higher. Look up after it, then reach up and try to push it down.
performanceSteps: Pull up a suitcase handle
Watch the handle rise too high, then reach up and push it down.

variants.text: You pull up a suitcase handle, but it won't extend. Bend over, steady the suitcase with one hand, and carefully tug with the other.
performanceSteps: Pull up a suitcase handle
Bend over, hold the suitcase steady, and tug at the stuck handle.

groups.sharedAction: Look for a seat at the station

variants.text: You find a seat at the station, but it's so high your feet won't reach the floor. Stay in place, mime its height, and pretend your feet are dangling.
performanceSteps: Look for a seat at the station
Mime the tall seat and pretend your feet are dangling.

variants.text: You find a seat at the station, but it's so low your knees almost reach your chest. Bend your knees slightly, mime being cramped, then hold your lower back and straighten up.
performanceSteps: Look for a seat at the station
Bend slightly to mime the low seat, then support your back and straighten up.

groups.sharedAction: Look up at a sign for directions

variants.text: You look up at a sign for directions, but the arrows point both left and right. Point back and forth, scratch your head, and struggle to choose.
performanceSteps: Look up at a sign for directions
Point in both directions and scratch your head in confusion.

variants.text: You look up at a sign for directions, but the arrow points behind you. Look over your shoulder, check the sign again, then turn around in place.
performanceSteps: Look up at a sign for directions
Look behind you, double-check the sign, and turn around in place.

groups.sharedAction: Take a photo of the scenery

variants.text: You take a photo of the scenery, but the camera is zoomed in so far you can only see a tiny detail. Hold the phone farther away and repeatedly pinch to zoom out.
performanceSteps: Take a photo of the scenery
Move the phone away and pinch to zoom out.

variants.text: You take a photo of the scenery, but the camera is zoomed out so far everything looks tiny. Bring the phone closer and repeatedly spread your fingers to zoom in.
performanceSteps: Take a photo of the scenery
Bring the phone closer and spread your fingers to zoom in.
